Beneficial owners not recorded: the report says Bethia is 'presidido por Carlos Heller' and lists Carlos Heller Solari as board president and Pedro Heller Ancarola as director, but does not name them as owners; Heller Solari family ownership of Bethia is press-only. The report gives Megamedia's RUT 76.185.964-1 and legal domicile Av. Vicuna Mackenna 1370, Nunoa, Santiago (not filled, legal_name already on record). Group brands: Mega, Mega2, Meganoticias, ETC, Mega Go; radios Carolina, Infinita, Romantica, Tiempo, Disney, Candela. No state funding reported. Relationship between Megamedia S.A. and Red Televisiva Megavisión S.A. not confirmed officially; RUT of Megamedia S.A. not found.

Ownership press-only: La Tercera (11 Dec 2023) reports that on 24 Oct 2023 the 27.5% stake held by Discovery Communications Chile SpA was transferred to Inversiones en Comunicaciones Ltda, making Grupo Bethia (Heller Solari family) owner of 100% of Mega; Bethia Comunicaciones S.A. was renamed Megamedia in 2020. The Clinic (18 Nov 2025) says Bethia acquired 100% of Megamedia and names Carlos Heller as president of Mega. Not recorded as owners because no official source was read.
